dataset.role: author dataset README, not verified full journal model

dataset.single_product_assignment: every original demand is generic perishable cargo; no tomato or fish labels
dataset.inclusion: exact singleton feasibility certificates with K=n; reject a full instance iff some mandatory customer cannot be served alone
dataset.split: four complete-geometry leave-one-group-out folds; validate on next group in sorted hash order, train on other two groups; no train/test customer subsets

routing.service_times: original per-node values, 90 min/customer; depot service zero
routing.hard_customer_window: service_start in [TW_START,TW_END]; completion may exceed TW_END
routing.departure: independent continuous departure within original depot window; canonical latest feasible departure for a fixed ordered route
routing.max_vehicles: n_customers; mathematical nonempty-route bound, not a claim of an observed 100-truck fleet

quality.model: isothermal zero-order reference-shifted Arrhenius, specialized from IJPE kinetics
quality.clock: relative to each route's dispatch; warehouse ageing and pre-dispatch quality are outside this transport-retention model

main_Product1.role: median of three published rates, chosen before solver comparisons

quality.threshold_role: research acceptance requirement, not species-specific food safety standard

money.definition_U: benchmark distance cost for 1 km; author distance coefficient 1 EUR/km is numerically 1 U/km
money.reference_value_derivation: (5000 CNY/t /1000 kg/t)/(3 CNY/km)=5/3 km/kg; preserve this source value-to-distance-cost ratio when distance coefficient is 1 U/km
money.value_transfer_role: explicit cross-study relative economic calibration; NOT EUR-CNY exchange, fresh-cut vegetable market quote, or source 20t vehicle observation
money.value_mapping_role: declared linear transport-retention value approximation; source monetary loss shape specialized to chosen quality model, not an experimentally fitted price law

refrigeration.model: constant-temperature wall-heat-load cost proxy using author benchmark coefficients
refrigeration.time_boundary: departure through empty return; travel, waiting and service included

money.purchase_fixed_overhead_driver_wages: unconfigured common constants excluded; no fabricated absolute business profit
money.double_counting_rule: subtract transport and refrigeration from quality-adjusted value; do not also subtract the same monetary quality loss

evaluation.training_validation_conditions: complete Cartesian product of the 3 published kinetic profiles and quality thresholds [0.8,0.85], only on the geometries assigned to each role
evaluation.sensitivity_conditions: other five profile-threshold cells; never select the best test cell as the main result
evaluation.main_test_accounting: 47 cases predicted once out of fold; report geometry-group macro results as well as case-level results
evaluation.inference: four geometries are the spatial units; case variants and repeated seeds are not independent spatial replications
evaluation.baseline_contract: identical mandatory demands, flexible dispatch policy, quality/value model, hard constraints, vehicle bound and independent evaluation for every algorithm

limits: This is a new literature-grounded composite numerical benchmark, not reproduction of any complete source model.
Ideal isothermal transport is a declared simplification; no multi-compartment or coupled door-opening physics claimed.
At constant temperature the quality constraint reduces to a maximum dispatch-to-delivery age; this is not claimed as a new problem structure.
Only four distinct source coordinate geometries exist; window variants and repeated seeds are not independent new spatial samples.
No generated customers, coordinate perturbations, arbitrary time compression, market profit or MaskCO gain is claimed.
